cohort: Parents of children with Arthrogryposis Multiplex Congenita (AMC)
finding: The antenatal detection rate of arthrogryposis was low (37%), highlighting the need for enhanced screening criteria and improved care protocols.
mod_finding: Among ADCs, 29% delivered vaginally and 71% delivered by cesarean, compared to 44% vaginal and 56% cesarean deliveries among PDCs.
